caption: The drawing features two illustrations of the same object, a slanted writing desk or box. The main object is positioned centrally in the upper section of the paper and is rendered in color. It has a sloped, rectangular top divided into two greenish sections, which likely represent writing surfaces lined with green felt or leather. The sides and drawers of the box are depicted in a reddish-brown color, giving the appearance of wood, with gold handles on the drawers. Below and to the left, there is a smaller black-and-white line drawing, showing a perspective view with the writing surface partially open, exposing an internal compartment. This sketch mirrors the colored drawing above and includes the same drawer with a handle, providing a view of the desk’s structure and function. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, and the artist’s name, "Edna Rep," appears written in the lower right corner.
title: Lap Desk
